mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsip_trackers ( user_id, stock_symbol, conviction_period_years, total_capital_planned, partition_days, deployment_style, base_conviction_score, initial_invested_amount, initial_shares_held, status, current_partition_index, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{stockSymbol}, #{convictionPeriodYears}, #{totalCapitalPlanned}, #{partitionDays}, #{deploymentStyle}, #{baseConvictionScore}, #{initialInvestedAmount}, #{initialSharesHeld}, #{status}, #{currentPartitionIndex}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tracker_id, user_id, stock_symbol, conviction_period_years, total_capital_planned, partition_days, deployment_style, base_conviction_score, initial_invested_amount, initial_shares_held, status, current_partition_index, created_at, updated_at FROM dsip_trackers WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId}
SELECT * FROM dsip_trackers WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dsip_trackers WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stock_symbol = #{stockSymbol})
mapper.update: UPDATE dsip_partitions SET successful_executions_completed = successful_executions_completed + 1, capital_deployed_so_far = capital_deployed_so_far + #{amount}, active_conviction_score = #{activeConvictionScore}, total_lockin_percentage_count = #{totalLockinPercentageCount}, consistent_growth_count = #{consistentGrowthCount}, status = #{status}, partition_end_date = #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE partition_id = #{partitionId}

UPDATE dsip_trackers SET deployment_style = #{deploymentStyle}, base_conviction_score = #{baseConvictionScore}, current_partition_index = #{currentPartitionIndex}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId}
UPDATE dsip_trackers SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsip_partitions ( tracker_id, partition_index, partition_start_date, partition_days, partition_capital_allocated, successful_executions_completed, capital_deployed_so_far, active_conviction_score, total_lockin_percentage_count, consistent_growth_count, status, partition_end_date, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{trackerId}, #{partitionIndex}, #{partitionStartDate}, #{partitionDays}, #{partitionCapitalAllocated}, #{successfulExecutionsCompleted}, #{capitalDeployedSoFar}, #{activeConvictionScore}, #{totalLockinPercentageCount}, #{consistentGrowthCount}, #{status}, #{partitionEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dsip_partitions WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId} ORDER BY partition_index ASC

SELECT partition_id, tracker_id, partition_index, partition_start_date, partition_days, partition_capital_allocated, successful_executions_completed, capital_deployed_so_far, active_conviction_score, total_lockin_percentage_count, consistent_growth_count, status, partition_end_date, created_at, updated_at FROM dsip_partitions WHERE tracker_id = #{trackerId} AND status = 1 /* PartitionStatus.ACTIVE */ ORDER BY partition_index DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsip_executions ( tracker_id, partition_id, execution_date, lock_in_percentage, conviction_override, executed_amount, execution_price, last_executed_avg_price, created_at ) VALUES ( #{trackerId}, #{partitionId}, #{executionDate}, #{lockInPercentage}, #{convictionOverride, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{executedAmount}, #{executionPrice}, #{lastExecutedAvgPrice, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{createdAt} )
